parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user who calls this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed **1** day. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return in a single call. Valid values: **1 to 100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc** (default): ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the stream. Make sure that the specified stream name exists within the query time range.
